paragraphs: Rabbi Yonatan ben Akhinai. (Of the first generation of the amoraim of the Land of Israel.)

Shabbat 49a relates: Rabbi Yonatan ben Akhinai and Rabbi Yonatan ben Elazar were sitting, with Rabbi Ḥanina bar Ḥama sitting beside them, and a question arose. Rabbi Yonatan ben Elazar said to him … Rabbi Ḥanina bar Ḥama said to him, “Thus said Rabbi Yishmael son of Rabbi Yosi” … They were again sitting, and a question arose. Rabbi Ḥanina bar Ḥama said to him … Rabbi Yonatan ben Elazar said to him, “Thus said Rabbi Shimon son of Rabbi Yosi ben Lakunya.”[^1]

notes.text: The ellipses represent Hyman’s abbreviated account: he does not supply the questions or the intervening answers. The translation preserves the named speakers and does not decide the unspecified recipients of “to him.” The checked William Davidson text of Shabbat 49a:13–14 and its continuation at 49b:6–7 explicitly supplies the full Rabbi titles for Yonatan ben Akhinai, Yonatan ben Elazar, Ḥanina bar Ḥama, Yishmael son of Yosi, and Shimon son of Yosi ben Lakunya. These matching occurrences support the title expansions, including ר״ח and ר״ש. The heading follows the supplied spelling עכינאי rather than silently replacing it with the earlier provisional עכנאי. The generational classification is Hyman’s statement. Hyman’s Shabbat מט. begins at 49a; the abbreviated second discussion continues at 49b. Both parts were checked without supplying Hyman’s omitted questions and answers. No new native-page or boundary review was performed.
